incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: p95 latency SLO violations detected on routing service (ap-northeast) — repeated reroutes observed. Auto-fallback triggered 18 times in last 12m. Paging oncall: @oncall-ml

oncall-ml: ack. I’m looking. Any immediate CX impact reported?

sre-anna: seeing a feedback loop on the routing decision engine — when p95 > 1200ms we reroute to fallback region/model, that increases latency in target path and retriggers reroute back. logs: `router.event: reroute -> fallback (variant=babbage-8b-q4)` then `fallback->primary (variant=redwood-13b-fp16)` in < 30s repeatedly.

eng-runtime-lead: heads-up — config drift after last week's rollout: the fallback policy allowed switching to a higher quality variant (not the lighter variant). That means fallback sometimes picks a heavier model which raises latency. Policy snippet: ```json
{"policy": "latency_slo", "primary": "redwood-13b", "fallbacks": ["redwood-70b", "babbage-8b-q4"]}``` Should have been ordered by latency not quality.

oncall-ml: copying logs — attached top sample: ```
[1965432087] route_decision: primary->fallback chosen reason=p95>1200, candidate_variants=[redwood-13b, redwood-70b (est+60%), babbage-8b-q4 (est-30%)]
[1965432091] route_decision: fallback->primary chosen reason=fallback_p95>1200
```

support-james: customers reporting slow responses via support channels — 3 enterprise customers on APAC region flagged degraded performance and higher timeouts. CS alerted.

cs-maya: confirmed — Customer A report: multiple timed-out requests for a chat endpoint between 12:02-12:10 UTC, volume ramped ~2x during that window. Impacting non-critical workloads but causing retries upstream.

infra-ops-lee: capacity in ap-northeast shows CPU on serving nodes at 85% and GPU memory spiking. Not seeing node failures. Autoscaler hasn't kicked in because reserved pool threshold not hit.

eng-runtime-lead: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable cross-region fallback for this routing policy (stop oscillation), 2) pin variant to a low-latency family (babbage-8b-q4) for 10m, 3) raise p95 threshold temporarily to avoid flip-flopping while we fix policy ordering.

oncall-ml: do 1 + 2 now. Please run change with canary off. I’ll coordinate with infra.

eng-runtime-lead: applying now -> `routerctl set-policy --id latency_slo --fallbacks "babbage-8b-q4" --mode hold`
eng-runtime-lead: applied. Verifying route behavior...

sre-anna: seeing reroutes drop from 18 -> 1 in last 3m. p95 trending down to ~980ms.

infra-ops-lee: scaling up ap-northeast reserved pool by +2 serving nodes (manual). Expected capacity add in ~90s.

support-james: filing PSR ticket for impacted customers. Noting retries and 504s.

cs-maya: Customer A updated — they see improvement starting ~12:08 UTC, will keep monitoring.

eng-runtime-lead: root cause: misordered fallback list — policy author accidentally appended high-latency variant at top. Long-term fix: validate fallback by estimated latency and reject configs where fallback_estimate > primary_estimate. Opening PR now for config validation.

pm-priya: please include a short incident summary and mitigation steps for postmortem. Also want an action item: add automated unit that simulates SLO-triggered reroute to catch oscillation loops in CI.

oncall-ml: handoff in 1h — @sre-anna will take night coverage; I’ll update oncall doc with commands used: `routerctl set-policy --id latency_slo --fallbacks "babbage-8b-q4" --mode auto` to re-enable when safe.

sre-anna: taking over. Will keep watch and follow up with a full incident timeline. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: NOTE: incident created ID INC-2026-0421-09, severity=sev2, summary="Routing oscillation due to fallback policy misconfig (ap-northeast)". Links: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-0421-09

eng-runtime-lead: follow-ups: (1) validate fallback ranking by estimated latency, (2) add hysteresis to routing decisions (min hold time 60s), (3) add alert that triggers when >5 reroutes per 10m for same request id. I’ll file JIRAs.

cs-maya: logged impacted customers and emailed status update.

support-james: closing support escalations as customers report recovery. Will reopen if new reports come in.

sre-anna: last check at 12:28 UTC — p95 stable at ~740ms, reroute count back to baseline. Marking incident as mitigated. Will collect logs for postmortem.

oncall-ml: final handoff: leaving detailed runbook in thread and tagging oncall rotation. Good work team. :coffee:
